name: Squelch Box Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Acid bass sounds with their own basslines for Squelch Box, a faithful acid bass synth inspired by classic acid bass synths: acid house, acid techno, electro, trance, house, minimal, deep acid and breakbeat. Each tune has a main pattern in slot 1 and a variation in slot 2. Checked for range and finite output, not listened to.
